root.label: Pointers to members
root.note: A path to a member of some class, applied to an object later with .* or ->*.

children.label: Forming and applying
children.note: &S::m with a qualified name, used as obj.*pm or ptr->*pm.

children.label: Qualified name only
children.note: &(S::m) or &m inside a member gives an ordinary pointer to this object's member.

children.label: Call parentheses
children.note: Write (obj.*pmf)(args); obj.*pmf(args) parses as obj.*(pmf(args)).

children.label: Value category
children.note: obj.*pm is an lvalue for an lvalue object and an xvalue for an rvalue object.

children.label: Not pointable
children.note: Static members give plain pointers; reference members and bit-fields cannot be pointed to.

children.label: Conversions
children.note: They run from base to derived, the reverse of object pointers.

children.label: Base to derived
children.note: T B::* converts implicitly to T D::* because D contains every member of B.

children.label: Derived to base
children.note: Needs static_cast; using it on an object lacking the member is undefined behavior.

children.label: Forbidden bases
children.note: No conversion through an inaccessible, ambiguous or virtual base.

children.label: Declaring class type
children.note: &D::x for a member of B has type int B::*.

children.label: Virtual functions
children.note: A pointer to a virtual function dispatches on the dynamic type when called.

children.label: No non-virtual form
children.note: Only a qualified call like b.B::f() suppresses dispatch; member pointers cannot.

children.label: Representation
children.note: Implementation practice only; the standard fixes no size or layout.

children.label: Itanium data pointer
children.note: One ptrdiff_t holding the member offset, with -1 as the null value.

children.label: Itanium function pointer
children.note: Two words: function address or vtable offset, plus a this adjustment.

children.label: Virtual flag
children.note: Low bit of ptr on x86-64, low bit of adj on AArch64 including arm64 macOS.

children.label: MSVC
children.note: Size depends on the inheritance model of the class.

children.label: invoke and projections
children.note: Library wrappers make member pointers ordinary callables.

children.label: std::invoke
children.note: Accepts objects, pointers, smart pointers and reference_wrapper; data members return references.

children.label: std::mem_fn
children.note: Wraps a member pointer in a reusable function object.

children.label: Projections
children.note: ranges::sort(v, {}, &P::age) compares by a field through std::invoke.

children.label: Overloaded members
children.note: An overload set has no type, so the target type selects the member.

children.label: Target type
children.note: A typed variable, parameter or static_cast picks the overload; auto cannot.

children.label: Library members
children.note: Forming &std::string::size is unspecified and possibly ill-formed; use a lambda.

children.label: Explicit object (C++23)
children.note: &S::f for f(this const S&) is an ordinary function pointer.
